artifact.description: Reproduction envelope for the completed State.eq-preserving PolCert milestone

default_candidate.review_status: candidate; requires its own successful full offline review evidence before publication

dependency_lock_origin.purpose: reviewed source of the captured dependency state only; not review evidence for the lock-v1 candidate

reproducibility.source_snapshot: exact git tree exported with git archive
reproducibility.dependency_state_enforcement: fail-closed after image resolution and again at offline review startup
reproducibility.dependency_lock_note: PolCert, Pluto, and the Pluto base registry digest are immutable pins. The dpkg and opam state was captured from the separately identified full-reviewed dependency-lock origin image. The lock-v1 candidate verifies that state after build and at review startup, but the origin evidence does not review the candidate wrapper. Apt repositories and opam source archives remain external, so resolution can fail or drift before the post-build check rejects it.
